definitions.explanation: Left without the covering it would normally have, so that it is plainly visible: bare skin, exposed wiring, an unwrapped banknote.
Of a feeling or attitude, shown openly without any attempt to hide or soften it. Usually a negative feeling such as hostility, rivalry, or desire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むき{出|だ}しだ。
⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's rude to hand over money without an envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むき{出|だ}しになって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{危|あぶ}なかった→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: Inside the old building the wiring was exposed, which was dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵意|てきい}→敵意：16853_tekii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧{心|しん}むき{出|だ}しだった。
examples.english: He made no secret of his rivalry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}しにしてぶつかり{合|あ}った。
examples.english: During the match, the players clashed with their emotions laid bare.

notes:
From ⟦{剥|む}く→剥く：02305_muku⟧ (to peel) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out). Also written {剥|む}き{出|だ}し. Used as むき{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun, むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb, or as a suffix after a noun (〜むき{出|だ}し).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{敵意|てきい}→敵意：16853_tekii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to show open hostility
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to let one's feelings show openly
- むき{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: bare skin
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むき{出|だ}す: to bare one's teeth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丸出|まるだ}し→丸出し：18909_marudashi⟧: completely exposed — often of something embarrassing (⟦{田舎|いなか}{者|もの}→田舎者：27627_inakamono⟧⟦{丸出|まるだ}し→丸出し：18909_marudashi⟧)
- ⟦{露骨|ろこつ}→露骨：18984_rokotsu⟧: blatant, undisguised — of attitudes and remarks only
